literal: Desiring to go behind him who was angry, pitiable indeed! Of what nature is the sorrow that has befallen me!
translation: Desiring to follow after the one who showed anger, how pitiable indeed is my state! What kind of strange grief is this that has come upon me?
modern: என்னிடம் கோபித்துக் கொண்டு சென்ற காதலரின் பின்னே போக விரும்புவதால், எனக்கு நேர்ந்த இந்தத் துன்பம் மிகவும் இரங்கத்தக்கது; இது என்ன வகையான துன்பமோ!
explanation: In this couplet, the heroine laments her complete loss of reserve and self-control. Although her lover has behaved coldly or departed in anger, her heart still desperately desires to follow him. She finds her own helpless state highly pitiable, as indicated by the words 'அளித்து அரோ'. She wonders what kind of strange, overwhelming grief ('எற்று என்னை உற்ற துயர்') has taken hold of her, forcing her to abandon her dignity and run after someone who showed her hostility.
